source_excerpts.text:
One-hour power loss

The intended hold relies on fine-pitch screws and positive mechanical retention, with the battery used for state preservation rather than load support.

However, finite dog engagement, coast, backlash, thermal drift and every intermediate stick-slip state have not been physically bounded. The model includes introduced finite allowances; it does not turn them into achieved hardware properties. SITEMA’s own spring-base documentation illustrates why release-under-load and finite travel require explicit treatment rather than an ideal lock command.
